content.text: **1 — not_equivalent.** The Flagship tiers (20% Class A / 15% Class F / none Class E) match, but the Co-Investment side is vague: it never states the 10% rate, the condition that carry is paid only after investors receive 100% of capital contributions and expenses, or the absence of a management fee. The Flagship high-water-mark/loss-carryforward and no-hurdle terms are also absent.

pairs.note: Flagship incentive allocation tiers (20% Class A, 15% Class F, none Class E) match the key. However, the Co-Investment Fund terms are only described generically as 'a lower carried interest on realized profits only' — the required 10% rate, the precondition that carry is payable only after investors receive 100% of capital contributions and expenses, and the absence of a management fee are all missing. The Flagship high water mark with loss carryforward, absence of a hurdle, and the December 31/redemption determination dates are also omitted. Missing required values and elements.
